title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de desenvolvimento
description:
Faça parte da transformação na Mosten

Na Mosten, transformamos desafios reais em soluções inteligentes e eficazes. Somos uma consultoria com 11 anos de história, atuando no Brasil e em Portugal, entregando soluções sob medida com foco em resultado, eficiência e evolução contínua.

Buscamos pessoas que queiram construir, propor e gerar impacto real em um ambiente colaborativo, orientado a resultados e inovação.


Sobre a posição

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior , com foco no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de soluções ligadas ao ecossistema NAVIS N4 , contribuindo diretamente para a continuidade e eficiência das operações do negócio.

A atuação será técnica e consultiva , exigindo forte capacidade de análise, autonomia e visão crítica para propor melhorias, apoiar integrações e atuar na resolução de demandas complexas. Essa pessoa terá interface com áreas internas e, conforme o contexto do projeto, também com clientes e equipes parceiras.


Principais responsabilidades

• Atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções relacionadas ao NAVIS N4

• Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações utilizando Java , Groovy e .NET

• Analisar demandas técnicas e propor soluções aderentes ao ambiente e às necessidades do negócio

• Apoiar integrações entre sistemas e garantir estabilidade nas entregas

• Atuar na identificação e correção de falhas, promovendo melhoria contínua dos serviços e aplicações

• Colaborar com áreas internas e times envolvidos no projeto, contribuindo com visão técnica e apoio consultivo

• Garantir qualidade, performance e confiabilidade nas soluções desenvolvidas


Requisitos

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software em nível sênior

• Conhecimento e atuação com NAVIS N4

• Experiência com Java

• Conhecimento em Groovy

• Vivência com .NET

• Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em demandas técnicas de maior complexidade

• Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado à resolução de problemas

• Boa comunicação e facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas


Diferenciais

• Experiência em projetos ligados a operações portuárias, logísticas ou terminais

• Vivência com integrações entre sistemas corporativos e plataformas operacionais

• Experiência em sustentação e evolução de sistemas críticos

• Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas interfaces técnicas


Modelo de trabalho

Local: Home Office

Contratação: Tempo determinado

title: Linux Server Manager
description:
Cargo: Linux Server Manager

Local de atuação: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Fluente

Contrato : 1 ano, podendo prorrogar.


Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project)

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery . Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents ), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.

Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project)

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery . Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents ), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.

  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

title: Consultor SAP FI Sênior - inglês avançado
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito?


Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente #Numen.


Prezamos por pessoas que:


Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;


Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;


Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;


E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na #Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser #Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo


#VemSerNumen

Responsabilidades e Atribuições


Suas principais atividades serão: Participar de projetos de implementação, melhorias, rollout;

Executar as atividades de projeto de acordo com o planejamento: Desenho/detalhamento de soluções, configurações, testes, documentações, suporte ao cliente;

Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução; Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto; Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes; · Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.


Requisitos e Qualificações


Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.


Para se candidatar você precisa dos seguintes requisitos e qualificações:


· Sólidos conhecimentos em SAP FI

· Experiencia com migração de dados e integração.

· Participação em projetos de Implementação, Rollouts, Melhorias, Upgrades.

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.


Imprescindível inglês avançado.

title: Staff ML Engineer - Contract
description:
Signify has partnered with a key client who is currently hiring a Staff ML Engineer to drive the productionisation and scaling of ML systems.


Staff ML Engineer (Contract)

Remote | 3–6 months | ASAP Start

Location - Remote - (The team is based on the East Coast)


What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end ML productionisation (deployment → serving → monitoring)
  • Build and scale batch & real-time model serving systems
  • Develop feature pipelines & feature serving infrastructure
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML (build, test, deploy)
  • Manage model lifecycle (versioning, retraining, rollout/rollback)
  • Ensure performance, reliability & observability (SLAs, logging, alerting)
  • Troubleshoot production issues & optimise ML systems


What they need

  • 7+ years in ML Engineering / MLOps / Data Engineering
  • Strong experience deploying ML models into production at scale
  • Hands-on with Databricks, MLflow
  • Strong coding skills (Python essential, Scala/Java nice to have)
  • Experience with AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Solid understanding of ML systems, pipelines & lifecycle management
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CDK)


If you are interested in this role, then please apply or send me a message.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Responsibilities

• Lead ABAP development team for all tax reform-related changes.

• Review enhancements, BADIs, exits, IDocs, RFCs, tax routines.

• Ensure code quality, performance, and technical consistency.

• Support integrations with tax engines and CRM.


Requirements

• Senior ABAP experience with Brazilian localization.

• Fluent English.


Technical Processes

• Tax routines and pricing logic

• NF-e/NFS-e technical integrations

• Performance tuning


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Desenvolvedor Abap Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) ABAP RAP / Fiori Sênior

Modelo: Remoto

Contratação: PJ ou Cooperado

Alocação: Tempo integral


Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior com forte experiência em ABAP RAP e Fiori , para atuar em projetos modernos dentro do ecossistema SAP, com foco em arquitetura limpa, extensibilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Buscamos um perfil hands-on , com visão técnica sólida e capacidade de atuar em ambientes com alto nível de exigência e qualidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções utilizando ABAP RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model)
  • Construir e manter aplicações SAP Fiori (UI5/Fiori Elements)
  • Criar e consumir serviços via OData
  • Desenvolver artefatos como CDS Views, Behavior Definitions e Service Definitions
  • Atuar com boas práticas de arquitetura e desenvolvimento SAP
  • Participar de definições técnicas e evoluções de arquitetura
  • Garantir qualidade, performance e aderência a padrões


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com ABAP moderno
  • Experiência prática com RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model)
  • Conhecimento em SAP Fiori (UI5 ou Fiori Elements)
  • Experiência com OData Services
  • Domínio de CDS Views
  • Vivência em projetos SAP S/4HANA


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em ABAP Cloud
  • Experiência com conceitos de Clean Core
  • Vivência com BTP (Business Technology Platform)
  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model)
  • Experiência com Adobe Forms


Perfil desejado

  • Sênior, com autonomia técnica
  • Proativo e organizado
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e funcionais
  • Capacidade de propor melhorias e soluções

title: Desenvolvimento Salesforce - 131447
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com (Salesforce).

Responsabilidades:

Será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de funcionalidades na plataforma Salesforce, apoiando a implementação de soluções em Service Cloud e Digital Engagement, seguindo as melhores práticas da plataforma;

Atua em colaboração com desenvolvedores seniores e arquitetos para entregar soluções de qualidade dentro dos padrões técnicos definidos.

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades na plataforma Salesforce Service Cloud;
  • Apoiar a implementação de Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots);
  • Configurar e ajustar Omni-Channel Routing;
  • Desenvolver funcionalidades utilizando Apex;
  • Criar componentes utilizando Lightning Web Components (LWC);
  • Criar e manter Flows para automação de processos;
  • Desenvolver integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST e SOAP;
  • Apoiar atividades de troubleshooting e análise de logs;
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas da plataforma e aos governor limits;
  • Participar de deploys e versionamento de código

Requisitos :

  • Experiência com Salesforce Service Cloud;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Apex;
  • Experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC);
  • Experiência com Flows;
  • Experiência em integrações via REST ou SOAP;
  • Conhecimento de Omni-Channel;
  • Noções de Digital Engagement (Chat / WhatsApp / Bots);
  • Conhecimento de governor limits.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Copado Certificação Salesforce Platform Developer I;
  • Experiência prévia com Service Cloud implementations.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Analista de Dados SR


Modalidade : Remoto


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá experiência em análise de dados, desenvolvimento de processos ETL e habilidades sólidas em programação com Python, além de conhecimento em SQL e serviços da AWS. O Analista de Dados será responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações valiosas para tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades :

- Extrair, transformar e carregar (ETL) dados de diversas fontes, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações.

- Desenvolver e otimizar scripts em Python para automação de processos e análise de dados.

- Criar e manter consultas SQL para manipulação e extração de dados de bancos relacionais.

- Trabalhar com ferramentas e serviços da AWS para armazenamento, processamento e análise de dados (ex.: Amazon S3, Redshift, Athena).

- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções analíticas.

- Produzir relatórios e dashboards que ajudem na visualização e interpretação dos dados.

- Monitorar e melhorar continuamente os processos de dados, propondo soluções inovadoras.


Requisitos :

- Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.

- Experiência comprovada em programação Python para análise de dados.

- Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais.

- Experiência em processos de ETL e ferramentas relacionadas.

- Familiaridade com serviços da AWS, especialmente em soluções de armazenamento e processamento de dados.

- Habilidade em comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

- Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma criativa e analítica.


Diferenciais :

- Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex.: Tableau, Power BI).

- Experiência com Big Data e tecnologias como Hadoop ou Spark.

- Certificações relevantes na área de análise de dados ou AWS.

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Tech Systems Analyst
description:
We are looking for a strong Java Application Support Engineer to join our global Financial Services application support team, made up of team members in the United States, Brazil, and India. In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Deployment experience using Jenkins is highly preferred. Our team works in an Agile Scrum environment with daily stand-ups and sprint meetings. You will be a part of an on-call rotation once you are trained on our applications.


Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 5:00AM - 2:00PM BRT


Responsibilities:

  • Java application support
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications
  • Debug software components, identify, fix, and verify remediation of code defects (own work and the work of others)
  • Support and maintain projects developed by the team and assist in production deployment and outages
  • Configure, deploy, debug, monitor, and document new system features and enhancements using Jenkins
  • Successfully communicate designs, research, and potential issues with team members
  • Collaborate with business professionals to determine functional and non-functional requirements for software development projects.
  • Participate in rotational 24x7 on-call 3rd/4th level support


Qualifications:

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 4+ Years of Java/J2EE application support experience
  • 2+ years of Relational Database experience
  • 2+ years of CI/CD tools (Jenkins)
  • 2+ years of experience on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design principles
  • Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Excellent organizational skills, self-administration, attention to detail, multi-tasking, and effective prioritization
  • Strong interpersonal and English communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to meet objectives
  • Experience with the following technologies preferred:
  • Spring/Spring-MVC/Spring Batch/Spring Boot is a plus
  • Tomcat, JBoss
  • REST Services, SOAP Services
  • Relational Database experience
  • JIRA & Confluence
  • Dynatrace & Splunk

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Recruiter based in Latin America with 2 to 5 years of experience and excellent English skills, who has a keen eye for detail and a knack for finding ways to get it done.


We are a growth-stage company that works fast and smart. We want ambitious people who want to grow their skills. At Velozient, you will feel your contribution daily to the success of the team! We are not a huge company where you will get lost in the mix or stuck in a role.


Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the Talent Pipeline and candidate engagement.
  • Conduct 1:1 interviews with qualified candidates.
  • Continuously assess and improve the recruitment process for efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Screen all the candidates and evaluate their fit for the opening.
  • Implement best practices to streamline workflows and enhance the overall recruitment experience.
  • Proactively conduct the full life cycle of identifying, engaging, and evaluating top candidates.
  • Collaborate with internal Resource Managers to ensure Velozient meets and exceeds client hiring goals, budgets, and performance standards.
  • Assure accurate/timely issuance of offer letters and clean/effective transition of candidates to the onboarding team.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in Recruiting, with at least two years in Technical Recruitment.
  • Proficiency in using social media platforms for networking purposes.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Familiarity with ApplicantTracking Systems and other recruitment tools is a plus.


Preferred (But not required):

  • University degree
  • Prior work for another North American-based company
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, growth-stage, entrepreneurial company


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados AWS
description:
Profissional para construir e escalar pipelines em Databricks/Spark na AWS, suportando iniciativas de AI/ML e projetos de analytics/BI, em colaboração com times globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar pipelines em Databricks/Spark (batch/streaming) com qualidade, performance e observabilidade.
  • Integrar e orquestrar dados na AWS (S3, Glue, Athena/Redshift), garantindo governança e segurança.
  • Construir datasets e pipelines para AI/ML (feature engineering, dados para treino e inferência).
  • Atender demandas end-to-end de dados para produtos e BI (ingestão, transformação e disponibilização).


Requisitos:

  • Domínio de Databricks e Apache Spark em produção.
  • Experiência prática com a stack AWS para dados/analytics.
  • Forte base em SQL e Python, com boas práticas de versionamento e CI/CD de dados.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para reuniões com times globais.

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Build high-quality, maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Develop APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, security, and scalability
  • Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Implement AI-powered features using foundation models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
  • Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability best practices
  • Collaborate in English on a daily basis with cross-functional and international teams

Technical Requirements

Frontend

  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Proficiency with modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Solid experience with Node.js (Express and/or NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI or Django)

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or AWS Aurora
  • Experience with Vector Data Stores (Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone)

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway) or GCP
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK)

AI & Orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (working with foundation models like Claude or Llama)
  • Experience with Google Vertex AI
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG architectures

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Experience with Docker and GitLab CI
  • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Google Cloud Logging

Testing

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, or Cypress

Developer Tools

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

Language Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Desenvolvedor FullStack Cloud - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias nos sistemas bancário


O que esperamos de você:

• Experiência em desenvolvimento para nuvem

• Experiência em desenvolvimento plataforma baixa (Java )

• Experiência em Angular 6 ou superior

• Experiência em Banco de dados Relacional


Requisitos Desejáveis

• Experiência em API Rest

• Experiência em Testes Unitários, Integrados, API, Front

• Conhecimento de modelagem para microsserviços (desejável)

• Conhecimento ou ter trabalhado com serviço de nuvem Oracle


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Arquiteto de Dados Júnior
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Mid-Level Data Architect (AWS) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Design and Improve an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines;

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices.

Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation.

Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues.

Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data.

Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake.

Demonstrated experience with container orchestration technologies.

Implement data ingestion pipelines, transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency.

Mandatory Skills:

3+ years Hands-on experience leading the modeling, development and deployment of Data & Analytics solutions;

Agile Methodologies;

English (speaker);

At least experience in 3-4 projects with Multidimensional data modeling;

Cloud Services (AWS) data applications building and data pipelines creation/curation;

Database programming advanced level (AWS Redshift, SQLDW, Postgres, SQL expert);

Strong understanding of Linux and distributed systems is a plus;Experience with Kubernetes is required;

Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform);

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) and GitOps practices;

Knowledge of application metric monitoring tools and logs (Grafana, Kibana, Cloud Logging/Log based metrics, etc.);

Knowledge of open-source table formats (Delta Lake and Iceberg);

Previous experience on serverless architecture (Spark, glue, Lambda functions);

Previous experience with Stored Procedures and UDF’s and Talend tool;

Multidimensional modeling (Star Schema and Snowflake) and Data Warehouse concepts.

Desirable Skills:

High level of autonomy & good communication;

Opening to understand what has been required by the PO;

Adaptability;Good attitude and insatiable hunger for knowledge is an extreme mandatory item

title: Arquiteto de Dados Júnior
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Mid-Level Data Architect (AWS) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Design and Improve an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines;

Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices.

Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation.

Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues.

Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data.

Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake.

Demonstrated experience with container orchestration technologies.

Implement data ingestion pipelines, transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency.

Mandatory Skills:

3+ years Hands-on experience leading the modeling, development and deployment of Data & Analytics solutions;

Agile Methodologies;

English (speaker);

At least experience in 3-4 projects with Multidimensional data modeling;

Cloud Services (AWS) data applications building and data pipelines creation/curation;

Database programming advanced level (AWS Redshift, SQLDW, Postgres, SQL expert);

Strong understanding of Linux and distributed systems is a plus;Experience with Kubernetes is required;

Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform);

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) and GitOps practices;

Knowledge of application metric monitoring tools and logs (Grafana, Kibana, Cloud Logging/Log based metrics, etc.);

Knowledge of open-source table formats (Delta Lake and Iceberg);

Previous experience on serverless architecture (Spark, glue, Lambda functions);

Previous experience with Stored Procedures and UDF’s and Talend tool;

Multidimensional modeling (Star Schema and Snowflake) and Data Warehouse concepts.

Desirable Skills:

High level of autonomy & good communication;

Opening to understand what has been required by the PO;

Adaptability;Good attitude and insatiable hunger for knowledge is an extreme mandatory item

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.


Highlight Role of the Week!


Executive Administrative Assistant (Remote)


About the role:


This opportunity is designed for experienced administrative professionals who are comfortable supporting leadership teams, coordinating business priorities, and ensuring operations run smoothly in fast-paced remote environments.


Pay Rates:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours.


Key responsibilities:


  • Executive Calendar Management: Coordinate complex scheduling across multiple time zones and manage executive priorities.
  • Inbox & Communications: Oversee executive inbox communication, draft professional responses, and manage internal/external correspondence on behalf of leadership.
  • Project Coordination: Coordinate projects across teams while ensuring deadlines and milestones remain aligned.
  • Reporting: Prepare executive summaries, presentations, and operational reports.
  • CRM & Systems: Support CRM management and maintain accurate operational records across platforms.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as a point of contact between executives, internal teams, clients, and vendors.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows and operational efficiency.


What you bring:


  • Must be 21+ years old
  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, or operations coordination roles
  • Bilingual English (C1 or above) /Spanish
  • Experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams


Required:


  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in remote environments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive) and/or Microsoft Office 365
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce) and project management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Monday or similar)
  • Comfortable with Slack, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Calendly, Canva, and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude)


How the process works


  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • Qualified candidates will receive instructions to complete their full application and join the Virtual Latinos community.
  • Once accepted, you will gain access to ongoing remote job opportunities with U.S. companies looking for experienced remote professionals.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities.


This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in C#/.NET with a deep understanding of portfolio and position management concepts, and an interest in modern development practices including AI-enabled engineering and specification-driven development.


Responsibilities:

- Portfolio Management Enhancement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve and extend portfolio management capabilities
  • Enhance portfolio aggregation, exposure calculation, and P&L reporting functionality
  • Improve intraday and end-of-day position workflows and controls
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives modernizing portfolio and position infrastructure


- Core Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services in C# / .NET
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Position Service architecture
  • Develop and enhance functionality within the Portfolio Management platform
  • Build scalable, resilient microservices supporting portfolio and order management workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices


- AI & Intelligent Systems

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and automation to enhance portfolio analytics, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational workflows
  • Collaborate on integrating AI-driven tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., intelligent code generation, review, testing, and documentation)
  • Contribute to the design of systems that enable advanced analytics and data-driven insights


- Specification-Driven Development


  • Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements
  • Translate business requirements into precise system specifications prior to implementation
  • Ensure alignment between architecture, documentation, and delivered functionality
  • Improve development velocity and quality through stronger upfront design and validation processes


- System Design & Optimization


  • Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions
  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers
  • Support both real-time and batch processing requirements


- Collaboration & Leadership


  • Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in C# and .NET (Core/Framework).
  • Experience building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.
  • Strong SQL and database design experience.
  • Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous programming.
  • Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.
  • Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, and cost optimization
  • Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong team player.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Oracle HCM Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:


Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you do?

  • Analyze and resolve technical issues within Oracle HCM;
  • Contribute to system enhancements and ongoing development activities;
  • Support data handling and data-related activities;
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure system stability and performance;
  • Work in an Agile environment.


What are we looking for?

  • 1 to 4 years of experience with Oracle HCM development;
  • Good understanding of HR data and processes;
  • Ability to analyze and solve issues independently;
  • Experience in Agile environments;
  • SQL knowledge is a plus;
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills;
  • Fluent in English (B2);
  • Available to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Analista de Infraestrutura Pleno


Atuará na sustentação, evolução e otimização da infraestrutura, com forte atuação em cloud AWS e integração com ambientes on-premises.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na administração e suporte de ambientes de infraestrutura híbrida (on-premises e cloud AWS)
  • Gerenciar e provisionar recursos na AWS (EC2, RDS, ALB, ECS, entre outros)
  • Monitorar desempenho, disponibilidade e segurança dos ambientes
  • Implementar melhorias contínuas em arquitetura e processos de infraestrutura
  • Administrar sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Suportar e interagir com bancos de dados (SQL Server, Oracle e MySQL)
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e operações na resolução de incidentes e troubleshooting
  • Documentar ambientes, processos e procedimentos técnicos


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como Analista de Infraestrutura (nível pleno)
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em cloud AWS
  • Experiência com ambientes híbridos
  • Administração de sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux
  • Vivência com bancos de dados SQL Server, Oracle e MySQL
  • Conhecimento em redes, segurança e monitoramento


Diferenciais

  • Certificação AWS
  • Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita)
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração (ECS, Docker, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)


Competências comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e proativo
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe
  • Organização e foco em resolução de problemas


Horário: 13:00 às 22h

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.

  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.



Responsibilities



Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members


Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution


Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices



Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively


Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!
